title: Yes Bitcoin can be boring...
description:
Investing in Bitcoin and Crypto can be boring when the market has periods of stagnation. But this is not a bad thing and Maria explains why.

Watch the full video here:  https://youtu.be/LwatdQuZjhI?si=dR78cxO98kd_GixY

👉 Remember to subscribe for more practical, crypto education - and together we’ll walk toward financial freedom.

#Crypto #Bitcoin #CryptoMindset #CryptoForBeginners #InvestingBasics #MariaCrypto #FinancialFreedom

asr.full_text: Yes, Bitcoin can be boring but that is a positive and not a negative. There is a large portion of the year where the price of Bitcoin is stagnant. It moves sideways, it hovers, by that I mean it goes up a little bit and it drops a little bit, and there are times when it drops. During that period, the public is dis interested in bitcoin and cryptocurrency. They don't wish to engage and they look for flashier investments. During the quiet time is when you should be considering purchasing bitcoin.
